title: MAPLE: Self-Supervised Learning-Enhanced Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction for Visual Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2601.20173v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a new nonlinear dimensionality reduction method, MAPLE, that enhances UMAP by improving manifold modeling. MAPLE employs a self-supervised learning approach to more efficiently encode low-dimensional manifold geometry. Central to this approach are maximum manifold capacity representations (MMCRs), which help untangle complex manifolds by compressing variances among locally similar data points while amplifying variance among dissimilar data points. This design is particularly effective for high-dimensional data with substantial intra-cluster variance and curved manifold structures, such as biological or image data. Our qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate that MAPLE can produce clearer visual cluster separations and finer subcluster resolution than UMAP while maintaining tractable computational cost.

translated_title: MAPLE：面向可视化分析的自监督学习增强非线性降维方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的非线性降维方法 MAPLE，该方法通过改进流形建模来增强 UMAP。MAPLE 采用自监督学习方法来更高效地编码低维流形几何结构。该方法的核心是最大流形容量表示（MMCRs），它通过压缩局部相似数据点之间的方差、同时放大不相似数据点之间的方差，来帮助解开复杂的流形结构。这一设计对于具有较大簇内方差和弯曲流形结构的高维数据（如生物数据或图像数据）特别有效。我们的定性和定量评估表明，MAPLE 能够产生比 UMAP 更清晰的视觉簇分离和更精细的子簇分辨率，同时保持可接受的计算成本。
tldr: MAPLE 是一种通过自监督学习和最大流形容量表示（MMCR）改进 UMAP 流形建模的非线性降维方法，能在保持计算成本可控的前提下，产生比 UMAP 更清晰的簇分离和更精细的子簇分辨率，尤其适用于高维生物和图像数据。
en_tdlr: MAPLE is a nonlinear dimensionality reduction method that enhances UMAP through self-supervised learning and maximum manifold capacity representations (MMCRs), achieving clearer cluster separations and finer subcluster resolution than UMAP at tractable computational cost, particularly for high-dimensional biological and image data.
